description: This file is a script used for interoperability testing of different git versions. It contains function definitions for building specific git versions, wrapping git commands, and setting up testing environments, along with variables to manage versions and paths.

methods.name: build_version
methods.description: Builds a specific version of git based on a given identifier or branch, caching the build in a directory structure.

methods.name: wrap_git
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script for git to emulate older git versions or set custom execution paths.

methods.name: generate_wrappers
methods.description: Sets up directory and wrapper scripts to facilitate testing across different git versions.
